snippet.title: Retrace the Light - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Rewind, Fight, Erase Their Obsessions!
The time-bending 2.5D action adventure RPG will officially launch on Steam and the Epic Games Store on ​​November 20, 2025, and is now in development for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Steam Link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179370?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=scheduled&utm_medium=pv
